• **Jean Martinon** – Recorded an earlier edition with the ONF (then sometimes listed as “Orchestre National de l’ORTF”) in 1984‑1985; the Discogs master for this release credits Martinon as conductor. | > **Historical name variants that were considered** > * The ONF has been listed over the years as:
• “Orchestre National de France” (the current name)
• “Orchestre National de l’ORTF” (prior to the 1989 re‑organisation)
• “Orchestre National de France (ONF)” (occasionally prefixed). > These variants were checked in Discogs — opening the master release page for the work and scrolling the *“Released By”* section shows the orchestra’s name at that time. **Bottom line** * For **Harold in Italy**, the only ONF‑only recording on Discogs belongs to Bernstein himself – no other conductor appears. * For **Symphonie fantastique**, two additional conductors have ONF recordings: **James Conlon** (the 1992 re‑issue) and **Jean Martinon** (the earlier 1984‑85 edition). These are the conductors found on Discogs up to 1 January 2025. No other conductors were found in the DISCogs database that meet the “ONF only performer” criterion.
